main_text.p: ptum adducere: vel denique qua ratione idem à vobis conseruari possit, & debeat, ignorantes, assi-duè scriptitando, declamandóque student cœtus illos Christianos (in quibus vera ac sincera illa diuini & Euangelici verbi prædicatio, & explicatio à legitimis pastorib. extat) omnino tollere, vel in odium ho-minum, ne ab vllis frequententur, rapere. Verùm vt eos prætermit-tam, qui vel armis Euangelium op-pugnant : vel sannis suis & con-temptione irrident.(quoniâ vtro-rumq; est manifesta impietas) de illo tertio dūtaxat hominū genere nunc dicam, qui sacros illos & E-uangelicos conuentus (qui sunt verissima Dei in his terris sedes,seu Ecclesia visibilis) vel damnant, vel aspernandos docent. Qui si animi morbo solo çontradicendi studio hoc

page.notes: Printed page with a running head "EPISTOLA." The catchword "hoc" is at the lower right. Doubtful readings: "ptum" (first word, fragment from previous line), "çontradicendi" and "quoniâ". The s long s has been rendered as plain s.
